candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes findings consistent with SLE (malar rash, chronic DVT, thrombocytopenia, prolonged PTT, elevated ESR/CRP, pericardial effusion, wrist stiffness) and explicitly states that nonbacterial thrombotic endocarditis was considered in the differential.
